The '''TR-286 transport'''<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> was a type of automated [[transport]] used in [[the galaxy]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. One TR-286, [[transport eight]], was present on [[Daiyu]] and was used to ferry [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to the [[mining]] [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]].<ref name="Part III" /> Many TR-286 transports were used on [[Epikonia]] to transport data-discs containing [[droid]] code updates to the surrounding [[sector]].<ref name="Dark Droids 4">[[Dark Droids 4|''Dark Droids'' 4]]</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The TR-286 transport was first pictured in the official trailer for the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series, which was released on [[May 4]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|3Yh_6_zItPU|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}}</ref> It first appeared in the [[Part II|second episode]] of the series,<ref name="Part III" /> which was released on [[May 26]], 2022.<ref name="Episode 2 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref>

In the series' script, the ship was described as an automated [[transport]], so propmaster [[Brad Elliott]] decided it was illogical to have a launch key designed for [[human]]s. The team decided to use a rigged [[scomp link]] [[computer]] interface device that had its own circuit board to simulate what an [[astromech droid]] would use to start the transport's launch sequence and program the route.<ref name="Brewing rebellion">{{SW|url=news/inside-the-lucasfilm-archive-obi-wan-kenobi-props-3|text=Inside the Lucasfilm Archive: A Brewing Rebellion in the ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Limited Series}}</ref>
